title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for private installer (terraform + helm + scripts)
author: Priya Natarajan
commits: a1c4d2f: add tenant RBAC policy canonical manifest
b7e9f11: terraform: new rbac module with outputs for installer
d4f2b3a: helm: expose rbac templates for private installer charts
e8a6c90: installer: idempotent tenant-bootstrap.sh and smoke checks
f2b8a44: tests: e2e coverage and flaky test guardrails
c3d5e99: docs: explain bootstrap flow, security considerations
description: Motivation: Private deployments require a deterministic, auditable way to bootstrap tenant-level RBAC and service accounts during installer runs (VPC/on-prem). This PR adds automation artifacts so the private installer and Terraform workflow can provision tenant roles and bindings safely and idempotently. Summary of changes: 1) canonical tenant RBAC manifest under policies/tenant_rbac_policy.yaml (roles, aggregated rules, least-privilege bindings for installer and bootstrapper). 2) Terraform module (terraform/modules/rbac) that exposes role templates, binding resources, and outputs required by the installer and examples. 3) Helm templates (helm/private/templates/rbac.yaml) to render cluster scoped and namespaced bindings for on-cluster operator flows. 4) Installer scripts (installer/bootstrap/tenant-bootstrap.sh) and an idempotent Python helper (scripts/ensure-roles-idempotent.py) to run RBAC provisioning during air-gapped installs; scripts are guarded with dry-run and audit-log options. 5) E2E smoke test and CI job (ci/ci-rbac.yml) to validate bootstrap in the private test harness. 6) Docs for operators (docs/operators/tenant-rbac-automation.md) that describe flows, required KMS/HSM integration points, and rollback steps. Compatibility: Designed to be backwards compatible with the existing private-installer when RBAC is not enabled; installer will default to pre-existing behavior unless the new terraform outputs or helm flags are provided. Security notes: roles are least privilege, service account tokens are not stored by the installer (only ephemeral during bootstrap), KMS-wrapped credentials are supported and documented. Testing: local unit tests added for terraform module inputs, helm lint passes, an e2e smoke harness validates idempotency. Migration: includes a migration check that will fail fast when existing clusters have conflicting bindings (see installer bootstrap script). Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented and validated with terraform plan - [x] Helm templates added and helm linted - [x] Installer script implemented and validated locally - [x] E2E smoke test added - [x] Docs added and internal runbook updated - [x] Security review requested (cc: Marisol) Related: ENG-2384 tracks the project to automate tenant provisioning for private installs.
review_comments: Ethan Garcia: Left a few nits around variable naming in terraform/modules/rbac/variables.tf — prefer 'tenant_id' over 'tenant' for clarity.
Priya Natarajan: Thanks Ethan — I renamed the variable and updated references. Kept a compatibility alias for existing examples to avoid breaking users.

Marisol Vega: Security review: roles look good but we should explicitly deny 'cluster-admin' escalation via aggregated ClusterRole in the manifest and add an audit annotation. Recommend adding an explicit test asserting no wildcard verbs on secrets in tenant roles.
Priya Natarajan: Added audit annotations and a small unit test to fail on wildcard verbs for secret resources. Updated policies/tenant_rbac_policy.yaml accordingly.
Li Wei: CI flaked on integration-tests initially due to timing in the e2e harness; added retry logic and increased the readiness timeout. Verified in the CI re-run.
Ethan Garcia: Approved after changes — LGTM.
release_notes: Adds automated tenant RBAC bootstrap support for private installer: terraform module, helm templates, idempotent bootstrap scripts, e2e smoke test, and operator docs. Operators: see docs/operators/tenant-rbac-automation.md for upgrade and rollback guidance.
